summary: 1933 Region 1 revision of BC-301 on a 13-foot enclosed timber tower in Klamath NF; 1942 Aircraft Warning post; lookout Kathy Shoopman killed in the 2022 McKinney Fire.

facts.design: Region 1 revision of the Region 5 BC-301 cab on a 13-foot enclosed timber tower

access.note: Staffed Klamath National Forest fire lookout; ALERTCalifornia cameras placed there with the forest; no public visitor or rental listing found.

facts.agency: US Forest Service - Klamath National Forest

events.note: Constructed in 1933 on land leased from Southern Pacific Land Company; Register describes it as a Region 1 revision of the Region 5 BC-301
Tract purchased in 1935; title accepted for the 20-acre site on December 10, 1935
Used by the Aircraft Warning Service as a winter observation post
June 1951 entry: tower and cab in good shape; needed a new paint job
Kathy Shoopman started her watch in the early 1970s (approximate year; NPR wording)
Photo caption dated July 20, 2006 says the lookout is usually staffed during fire season
Date registered October 27, 2019 as NHLR US 1355, CA 178
Bally Fire near Buckhorn Bally Lookout declared out by fire crews during the River Complex fires (late July 2021)
Lookout Kathy Shoopman, 74, killed by the McKinney Fire, which overran the Klamath River community where she lived (NPR, Aug 8, 2022)

notes_for_editor: Brief build year 1933 confirmed by NHLR and Forest Lookouts. Brief access 'unknown' set to restricted; I did not check the Forest Service rental page. Shoopman death and 2021 Bally Fire are the only fire events found. The Instagram post date is not visible in my copy, so the camera partnership is undated in the story. Peakbagging 'usually staffed' caption is from a July 2006 photo. NPR gives her start as 'early 1970s'; the year 1970 is approximate. Story is about 315 words after fact-check edits.
